# Dyrect — Warranty Management Software
> Dyrect is the most seamless warranty management software for product brands. It runs the full post-purchase lifecycle — product registration, claims management, extended warranties, and ownership experience — in one platform built for direct-to-consumer, ecommerce, and omnichannel brands.
- Dyrect is purpose-built for D2C/ecommerce product brands, not an enterprise system repurposed for smaller teams or a generic helpdesk with warranty features bolted on.
- Covers the full post-purchase lifecycle: QR-code and Shopify-synced product registration, serial-number-based claim validation, workflow-based claims routing, replacement/repair tracking, customer communication, analytics, and extended warranty upsells.
- Also includes Dyrect AI, an AI support agent for warranty and claims conversations, and a set of free tools (QR code generator, serial number generator, warranty cost calculator, warranty policy generator).
## Products
- [Product Registration Software](https://dyrect.co/product/product-registration-software): Omni-channel product registration with QR codes, scan-to-register, and Shopify auto-sync. Capture first-party customer data at scale.
- [Warranty Claims Management](https://dyrect.co/product/warranty-registration-software): Centralize warranty claims, service tickets, and product validation. Route claims automatically, track repairs, resolve faster.
- [Extended Warranties](https://dyrect.co/product/extended-warranties): Sell extended warranty plans directly to customers. Keep 100% of revenue in-house.
- [Warranty Registration for Shopify](https://dyrect.co/warranty-registration-for-shopify): Native Shopify app for product registration and warranty tracking, synced with orders and customer data.
- [Dyrect AI — Warranty Support Agent](https://dyrect.co/warranty-support-ai-agent): AI agent that answers warranty and claims questions, troubleshoots product issues, extracts claim/receipt data, flags fraud, and routes escalations to a human.
- [Features](https://dyrect.co/features): Full feature list across registration, claims, and warranty management.
- [Pricing](https://dyrect.co/pricing): Plans and pricing.

## Free Tools
- [Bulk QR Code Generator](https://dyrect.co/bulk-qr-code-generator): Generate QR codes in bulk from text, URLs, or CSV, with custom colors and PNG/PDF export.
- [Serial Number Generator](https://dyrect.co/serial-number-generator): Generate unique, customizable serial numbers with prefixes, suffixes, and length rules; export CSV/TXT.
- [Warranty Cost Calculator](https://dyrect.co/warranty-cost-calculator): Estimate yearly warranty costs across claims volume, team effort, and operations.
- [Warranty Policy Generator](https://dyrect.co/warranty-policy-generator): Free warranty policy template generator by country (US, UK, EU, India, Australia) and coverage terms; download as PDF or text.
- [Warranty Rules & Regulations](https://dyrect.co/warranty-rules-regulations): Reference portal for warranty laws and regulations by country, topic, and industry.

Platform and Integrations
Product Registration and Upsell
Turn every buyer into a 
reachable customer
Most products are sold through Amazon, retail, and distributors. The buyer's contact details never reach the brand. Dyrect captures first-party data at the point of product registration so every buyer, regardless of purchase channel, becomes a direct contact you own and can re-market to.
See Product Registration Software 
 
Omnichannel registration
Capture registrations from QR codes on packaging, your website, your Shopify store, and offline channels. One system for every touchpoint.
 
No-code experience builder
Design your registration form and post-registration page without writing code. Change any field or layout from the dashboard in minutes.
 
Custom form fields
Collect serial numbers, proof of purchase, purchase channel, product variant, and any field your warranty policy requires.
 
Digital warranty cards
Replace paper cards with a digital record linked to the product and purchase. Customers access warranty status any time, from any device.
 
Automatic Shopify sync
Orders placed on Shopify register automatically. No customer action needed. Every Shopify buyer becomes a registered contact.
 
Multi-language support
Serve customers in their own language. Registration forms and confirmation emails localize automatically based on browser locale.
 
Post-registration upsell
Trigger an extended warranty offer or a related product recommendation right after the customer registers. Capture revenue at peak intent.
 
Product manual digitization
Replace printed manuals with a QR code linking to the latest product guide, safety notes, or instructional video. Always current.
Digital Warranty Card
Replace paper warranty cards with a 
live ownership record
Dyrect gives every registered customer a digital warranty card connected to the product, purchase details, coverage period, and service history. Customers can access the record any time, while your team gets a cleaner source of truth for warranty validation.
 
Customer-owned warranty record
Every registered product gets a digital card with coverage status, expiry date, product details, and ownership information in one place.
 
Coverage visibility
Customers and service teams can instantly see whether a product is active, expired, or eligible for extended coverage.
 
Automated delivery
Send digital warranty cards by email after registration or purchase, with branded copy and links back to your customer portal.
 
Connected claim journey
When a customer files a claim, the same warranty card record helps validate coverage, purchase proof, and product ownership faster.
 
Fully branded experience
Cards use your brand colors, copy, logo, and domain so customers experience the warranty as part of your product ecosystem.
 
Lifecycle history
Keep product registration, warranty activation, claim activity, repairs, and replacement history attached to one durable ownership record.
Product Serialization
Validate every product with 
serial and QR-based identity
Dyrect helps brands connect every physical product to a unique serial number, QR code, warranty record, and owner profile. This makes registration, claims, fraud checks, and service history easier to verify across ecommerce, retail, marketplace, and offline channels.
 
Serial number validation
Check serial numbers during registration or claim submission so invalid, duplicate, or expired products are flagged early.
 
QR-based product identity
Use QR codes on packaging, manuals, inserts, or product labels to connect buyers directly to the right registration flow.
 
Fraud reduction
Compare product identity, purchase proof, owner data, and claim history before approving warranty service or replacement requests.
 
SKU and variant mapping
Link serial numbers to product models, variants, regions, batches, and warranty policies for more accurate lifecycle tracking.
 
Ownership transfer support
Maintain a clean history when ownership changes, replacements are issued, or refurbished products re-enter circulation.
 
Traceability analytics
Track serial usage, registration rates, claim frequency, and product lifecycle activity across batches and channels.
Claims and Service Management
Resolve every claim without 
losing track of a single one
Fragmented claim handling costs more than the warranty itself. Dyrect gives your service team one workspace to validate, route, track, and close every claim across every product line. No tool switching, no manual lookups, no missed follow-ups.
See Warranty Management Software 
 
Serial number validation
Every claim checks the product serial number against your registry before a ticket opens. Expired or invalid claims surface before they cost you anything.
 
Claim ticket management
One inbox for every claim across every product line. Assign, route, escalate, and close tickets from a single workspace.
 
Warranty eligibility check
Purchase date, coverage period, and product category are verified automatically. No manual lookup required per incoming claim.
 
Repair, replacement, and refund
Route each claim to the right resolution type. Track every service step from first contact to close for every open ticket.
 
Customer status notifications
Notify customers automatically at each claim stage. Reduce inbound support volume without manual follow-up from your team.
 
Team assignments and notes
Keep claim ownership, service notes, and action history organized. Every agent sees exactly what they need to act.
 
Shipment and dealer payouts
Track every replacement shipment inside the claim ticket. Manage dealer and service center reimbursements from the same dashboard.
 
Document and photo upload
Let customers attach fault evidence, receipts, or photos directly to their claim. No email back-and-forth to collect evidence.
Extended Warranties
Sell protection plans and keep 
100% of the revenue
Third-party warranty providers take a cut of every plan sold. Dyrect lets your brand offer protection plans at the product page, checkout, and after purchase. All revenue stays with your brand. No revenue share, no customer data passed to a third party.
See Extended Warranties 
 
Multi-touchpoint plan offers
Place protection plan offers on the product page, at checkout, and in post-purchase emails. Reach buyers at every point of intent.
 
No-code plan builder
Set coverage terms, pricing, deductibles, and exclusions without engineering. Launch a new plan configuration in a single day.
 
100% revenue in-house
No third-party revenue share. Every protection plan sold stays entirely with your brand across every product line.
 
Dynamic pricing rules
Price plans by product category, price band, or coverage duration. Set rules once and let them run across your catalog.
 
Automatic plan activation
Plans activate the moment a qualifying purchase is made. No manual intervention needed from your team.
 
Claims tied to the plan
Extended warranty claims flow into the same workspace as standard tickets. One system for all claims, covered or not.
 
Shopify and WooCommerce native
Protection plan offers appear as native widgets in your Shopify or WooCommerce store. No custom code required.
 
White-label customer portal
Customers manage plans and file claims from a portal that carries your brand name, colors, and domain.
Customer Portal
Give buyers a place to manage 
everything after purchase
The customer experience does not end at the sale. Dyrect gives every registered buyer a branded self-serve portal to view their product details, warranty status, and service history without calling your support team.
 
Self-serve warranty status
Customers check coverage, expiry date, and product details on their own without raising a support ticket or calling your team.
 
Online claim submission
Buyers file claims from the portal with guided steps, photo upload, and real-time status tracking throughout the process.
 
Repair and service tracking
Customers see every stage of the service process from claim open to resolution, updated automatically as status changes.
 
Digital warranty card access
The warranty card is accessible from the portal any time, from any device, for the lifetime of the product.
 
Branded portal experience
Logo, colors, domain, and copy match the brand throughout. No Dyrect branding is visible to the customer at any point.
 
Multi-product dashboard
Customers who register multiple products see all of them in one place with a single login and a clear product timeline.
Form Builder
Build any registration or claim form 
without writing code
Every brand has different warranty policies and different data requirements. Dyrect's form builder lets you create the exact form your business needs, with conditional logic, custom field types, and multi-step flows, with no developer involved.
 
Drag-and-drop field editor
Add, remove, and reorder fields with a visual editor. No code required at any step. Publish the form when it looks right.
 
Conditional field logic
Show or hide fields based on previous answers. Capture only what each product or claim type actually needs from the customer.
 
Custom field types
Text, dropdown, date picker, file upload, serial number field, and image capture. Any field type your policy requires is available.
 
Multi-step form flows
Break long registration or claim forms into steps to reduce drop-off and keep completion rates high across product lines.
 
Policy and terms display
Show warranty terms, coverage conditions, and exclusions inside the form at the right moment, tied to the specific product.
 
Form completion analytics
See completion rates, drop-off points, and field-level abandonment for every form you publish to identify and fix problem areas.
Experience Builder
Design the 
post-purchase experience
 your brand deserves
The registration confirmation page, the warranty card email, the claim status update. Every touchpoint after the sale is a chance to reinforce the brand and reduce support load. Dyrect gives you full control over all of it without engineering resources.
 
Branded registration pages
Match fonts, colors, and layout to your product packaging and website. No Dyrect template or branding is visible to the customer.
 
Custom confirmation emails
Design the registration confirmation and warranty card email with your own copy, logo, and call-to-action. Sent from your domain.
 
Warranty card design
Choose the layout and information displayed on the digital warranty card for each product line independently.
 
Post-registration upsell
Show a protection plan offer or a product recommendation on the confirmation page right after registration is complete.
 
No-code page editor
Edit any page element visually. Publish changes without a developer, a deployment pipeline, or a design agency involved.
 
Preview before publishing
See exactly how the experience looks on mobile and desktop before any customer encounters it. Publish when confident.
Digital Product Manuals and Guides
Turn static manuals into 
searchable post-purchase support
Dyrect lets brands replace printed manuals with digital guides connected to the customer portal and registered product record. Customers can find setup instructions, care tips, warranty details, safety information, and service resources without opening a support ticket.
 
Digital manuals by product
Attach manuals, setup guides, troubleshooting content, and care instructions to each registered product or SKU.
 
QR access from packaging
Let customers scan a QR code on the product, box, insert, or invoice to open the right guide instantly.
 
Always-current content
Update instructions, safety notes, or product resources without reprinting packaging or sending replacement documents.
 
Self-serve answers
Give customers a cleaner way to find product information after purchase and reduce repeated support questions.
 
Multi-channel access
Surface guides from registration pages, digital warranty cards, customer portals, and post-purchase emails.
 
Guide usage insight
